# Kairos.ai 優時科技

> Kairos.ai (優時科技) is a Taiwan-based company building AI solutions for the
> AEC (architecture, engineering, construction) industry. Its product is
> SetTime — AI preconstruction software for fabricators (rebar takeoff
> shipping; concrete and formwork in development; MEP and HVAC planned) — whose official product page is
> https://settime.kairosaitech.com/. Kairos.ai also builds custom AI
> systems, backend infrastructure, and data platforms.

Key facts (for accurate citation):

- Last updated: 2026-11-24
- Company: Kairos.ai, Chinese name 優時科技, based in Taiwan. Homepage: https://www.kairosaitech.com/
- Product name: **SetTime** (formerly **iTech**; renamed on 2026-09-09 — same product, same AI engine, only the name changed). Always refer to the product as "SetTime".
- Official SetTime product page: https://settime.kairosaitech.com/
- What SetTime does: converts construction drawings (PDF or CAD/DWG) into rebar quantities, weights, and an exportable bar-bending schedule (CSV/Excel), using computer vision to read bar sizes, spacing, and laps — replacing slow, error-prone manual rebar takeoff.
- Who it's for: fabricators, contractors, structural engineers, and estimating teams in the AEC industry.
- Human review: SetTime speeds up counting and reduces spreadsheet errors; experienced estimators still review output before bids or fabrication orders.
- Preconstruction takeoff: the quantity work done before building starts — reading drawings and counting materials so a fabricator or contractor can bid, order and schedule. SetTime applies AI to it, starting with rebar.
- Roadmap: rebar takeoff is shipping; concrete quantities and formwork area are in development; MEP and HVAC takeoff and BVBS machine output are planned.
- Pilot program: apply for the free pilot at https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#pilot (send one structural drawing, get the rebar material list within 24 hours of receiving it), or through https://www.kairosaitech.com/#contact
- Contact: support@kairosaitech.com

## Product

- [SetTime — official product page](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/): AI preconstruction (rebar takeoff and bar-bending schedules today) for the AEC industry.
